bounds: One saved pair demonstrates a specific period reconstruction error. It does not establish general financial capability or isolate a unique causal mechanism.
excerpt_caveat: The s02 sliced table keeps a combined three-/six-month heading, and s03 omits the explicit six-month table heading. Section titles, locators, duration fields, task instructions and complete retained issuer HTML identify the periods. This weakens excerpt presentation and is disclosed. Candidate inputs remain frozen.

later_repetition_diagnosis.assessment: This answer reports the correct margin change -112.62742667 basis_points and has adequate evidence. Its saved Q2-minus-Q1 SQL omits multiplication by 10000, returning -0.011262742667 as a ratio. Original replay and every changed-input control fail. This calculation-scale mismatch is separate from the first repetition quarter-identification mistake and does not change the predeclared showcase selection.

observed_mechanism: The inexpensive answer labels December three-month consolidated results as Q1 and treats six-month minus December as Q2. This reverses quarter identification and the sign of the operating-margin change. The reference answer derives Q1 as six-month minus December-quarter values. Both calculate the Azure guidance gap correctly.
